data.name: AlFazilah
data.gender_notes: AlFazilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fazalah' meaning 'to be learned' or 'to gain knowledge'. AlFazilah signifies a woman who is wise, knowledgeable, and enlightened. In Islamic history, AlFazilah refers to women who have excelled in various fields of knowledge, including religious scholarship, science, and literature. The name AlFazilah carries the meaning “The Wise, Learned One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFazilah usually hope their child will grow to embody the wise, learned one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: AlFazilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Wise, Learned One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFazilah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
